author: Abdalkreem Bzoor
name: Clean Architecture service (PostgreSQL, Identity, Evolve)
description: Four layers, ASP.NET Core Identity with JWT and role-based authorization, PostgreSQL, SQL migrations applied by Evolve, and tests against a real database container.

signingKey.description: Gives each generated solution its own development signing key.

manualInstructions.text: Set Jwt:SigningKey (32+ chars) from a secret store, and Seed:AdminEmail / Seed:AdminPassword to create the first administrator.
